not_covered.text: Israeli forces strike a mosque in Gaza City in violation of the ongoing ceasefire, accusing Hamas of using it to store weapons.
The Israel Defense Forces launches a drone strike in the Ali al-Taher ridge of southern Lebanon, while accusing Hezbollah of violating the ceasefire.
The IDF also claim that their 401st Brigade Combat Team and Yahalom Unit have destroyed a underground headquarters belonging to Hezbollah, located near a UNIFL post.
A drone strike targets a LNG storage tanker at the port of Damietta, Egypt. The group responsible for the strike is currently unknown.

Data from Kpler shows that 39 commercial vessels have transited through the Bab el-Mandeb yesterday, the highest since July 19, while another five transited it today, including the VLCC Sophia and the Aframax tanker ​Ocean Laureate.
Five soldiers are killed in a shootout with Al-Shabaab gunmen in Mandera County, Kenya.
A Bell 412 helicopter carrying seven people crashes while on a fire-fighting training operation in San Juan, Argentina. The conditions of the occupants is unknown.

Protesters gather outside the White House against Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's visit to Washington, D.C. and against Israel's genocide and military campaign in Gaza, and calls for the U.S. to comply with an arrest warrant iss
